prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Fill in a “USE OF DOCUMENTS MATRIX” for each inspection day to track how each code reference is delivered.
3. Create a narrative after each inspection day that walks through each accessibility item.

## Level I items – Self-evident, like grab bar location.
- Comment on required location as this item is very simple and straightforward. These are few in scope.

## Level II items – Measure, locate, identify, calculate, apply the code to make a positive determination.
- Some simplicity here as well. Must show how code was applied.
- E.g., “UAC 10.1.4 – Fire alarm horns – TIA verifier accessed second floor corridor (full Level III statement included below) measured the distance from existing fire alarm horns to finished floor elevation (FFE) of upper surface. A height of 66 inches was determined. By the terms of the TIA, this must be a minimum
